Features
Everything to keep
your Mac running fast.
MacCare scans 8 categories of system junk, finds duplicates, manages startup items and shows exactly where your storage went. Built-in safety makes sure nothing important gets deleted.
🧹
Junk Scanner
Scans 8 junk categories in parallel: caches, logs, temp files, app remnants, duplicates, downloads, mail attachments, system junk.
🗺
Visual Disk Map
See exactly where your storage went with an interactive TreeMap. Click into folders, color-coded by file type, with protected paths clearly marked.
🛡
Safety Guard
A built-in whitelist protects your Documents, Photos, Music, Mail and SSH keys. Every deleted file goes to Trash with full Put-Back support, never permanently removed.
📦
Complete Uninstaller
Removes apps along with all their hidden remnants: caches, preferences, containers, launch agents and logs. Finds what Finder misses.
⚡
Startup Optimizer
Manage Login Items, LaunchAgents and system daemons. Toggle items on or off with impact indicators to keep your Mac booting fast.
📊
Menu Bar Monitor
A small, always-visible disk space indicator in your menu bar. One click for a quick scan, plus your last cleanup stats at a glance.
🔍
Smart Cleanup
One scan. Two phases. Safe files are cleaned instantly. Then you review suggestions one by one with previews.
🎵 For Creative Professionals
Audio Producer Mode
Use Logic Pro, Ableton or Pro Tools? MacCare automatically detects your DAW and protects all audio-related files like plugins, sample libraries, presets and caches. No other cleaner does this.
One toggle. Total protection. Clean your Mac without fear of breaking your setup.
